definitions.explanation: Describes actions, behavior, or people that are deliberately harmful or deceptive.
Describes things of low or harmful quality, such as products, conditions, or substances.

examples.japanese: {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦いたずら→いたずら：01794_itazura⟧。
{悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{騙|だま}された→騙す：02286_damasu⟧。
examples.english: I was tricked by a malicious scam.

examples.japanese: {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{嫌|いや}がらせ→嫌がらせ：12225_iyagarase⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いていて→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧、⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}した→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧。
examples.english: The malicious harassment continued, so I consulted the police.

examples.japanese: {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土壌|どじょう}→土壌：12040_dojou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{悪質|あくしつ}で⟦{作物|さくもつ}→作物：02823_sakumotsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{育|そだ}たない→育つ：01951_sodatsu⟧。
examples.english: The soil is of poor quality and crops won't grow.

examples.japanese: {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{売|う}りつける→売りつける：29380_uritsukeru⟧⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: Sellers pushing poor-quality products have become a problem.

notes:
Describes something that is bad either in intention or in quality. When applied to people or actions, it implies deliberate malice; when applied to things or conditions, it means inferior or harmful quality.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧: malicious scam/fraud
- {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→業者：13130_gyousha⟧: unscrupulous dealer
- {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{嫌|いや}がらせ→嫌がらせ：12225_iyagarase⟧: vicious harassment
- {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{違反|いはん}→違反：01824_ihan⟧: flagrant violation
- {悪質|あくしつ}な⟦{腫瘍|しゅよう}→腫瘍：23364_shuyou⟧: malignant tumor

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{悪意|あくい}→悪意：19922_akui⟧: malice, ill will — refers to the intention itself, not the quality of an action
- ⟦{劣悪|れつあく}→劣悪：11917_retsuaku⟧: inferior, poor — focuses on quality being extremely low
- {卑劣|ひれつ}: despicable, underhanded — emphasizes moral contempt
